component.name: Lingueez
component.summary: Study and build vocabulary across languages

description.p: Lingueez is a desktop app for studying vocabulary across languages. Add words from anywhere, translate and listen to them, track your learning progress, and review with built-in read-aloud.
A new Quiz page tests your vocabulary with multiple-choice or typed answers.
Flashcards carry playback controls in the transport row, and a word can be set aside without leaving the session.
The navigation rail expands to show labels, and syncing keeps edits, tags and listen counts in step across devices.
The interface is now available in 32 languages, and the Windows installer speaks them too.
Adding a word can fill the lemma and its translation with AI, and opens on the languages you used last.
Flashcards can end a session with a drill on the cards you graded Hard.
Lingueez is now available as a Flatpak.
